i_schipperke.lore.legendary: Was made honorary harbour master of the whole canal. Every barge must now stop, show its sandwiches and wait to be sniffed.
i_schipperke.lore.epic: Chased one rat the full length of a cargo ship, through every cabin. The crew found the rat asleep in the captain's hat.

i_scotch_terrier.lore.rare: Dug up the castle lawn hunting one mole, then presented the hole to the gardener as a gift.
i_scotch_terrier.lore.epic: Barked at a bagpipe until it stopped. The whole Highland band now plays only when the terrier is asleep.

i_scottish_deerhound.lore.epic: Stood up to say hello and rested its chin on the roof of the bus. The bus waited politely until it had finished.

i_sealyham_terrier.lore.epic: Went down a badger sett in a white coat and came out brown. The badgers now think it is one of them and send it party invitations.

i_shetland_sheepdog.lore.legendary: Herded the ferry passengers into a queue so neat that the island ferry now leaves early every single day.
i_shetland_sheepdog.lore.rare: Herds the children at every birthday party into one corner of the garden, then barks until the cake comes out.

i_shih_tzu.lore.rare: Its silky coat sweeps the floor so well that the house has not needed hoovering in a year.
i_shih_tzu.lore.epic: Snored so loudly through the wedding dinner that the band played along to keep in time.

i_siberian_husky.lore.uncommon: Digs a cool hole in the flowerbed on every warm day and lies in it like it's on holiday.

i_silky_terrier.lore.legendary: Had its silky coat brushed so long and straight that the town theatre hired it as the curtain. Takes a bow every night.
i_silky_terrier.lore.common: Barks at the kookaburra every morning. The kookaburra laughs back, and it has never once won.
i_silky_terrier.lore.epic: Chased a whole flock of cockatoos off the school roof. They moved onto the headmaster's car instead.

i_soft_coated_wheaten_terrier.lore.rare: Its coat frizzes into a cloud in the rain, so on wet days the farmer keeps trying to shear it.
i_soft_coated_wheaten_terrier.lore.epic: Shook itself dry after a swim at the summer fair and frizzed every hairdo at the bandstand.
i_soft_coated_wheaten_terrier.lore.legendary: Said hello so hard at the airport that every plane had to circle until it calmed down.

i_staffordshire_bullterrier.lore.rare: Grins so widely that strangers grin back, then carries a whole log home from the park in that grin.

i_standard_poodle.lore.epic: Shook its pompoms dry at the lakeside café and every customer got a free shower.

i_sussex_spaniel.lore.epic: Frowned so seriously at the village fete that the coconut shy closed early out of respect.

i_tibetan_mastiff.lore.legendary: Guarded one mountain gate so faithfully that it now checks tickets for the whole range. Even the snow needs a pass.
i_tibetan_mastiff.names.legendary: Old Thundermane, Keeper of the Pass

i_toy_poodle.lore.legendary: Taught itself to walk on its back legs so well that it queues at the bakery on its own, and the baker now bows back.

i_toy_terrier.lore.rare: Its ears are so big and pointy that they pick up the radio. It barks along to the weather forecast.
i_toy_terrier.lore.common: Shivers on a warm day, under a blanket, by the fire, and still asks for your jumper.

i_vizsla.lore.legendary: Pointed at a pheasant from a hot-air balloon and held the point so hard that the balloon drifted over to it. The pheasant was very surprised.

i_walker_hound.lore.legendary: Treed a raccoon so often that the raccoon now leaves a note on the tree saying where it has gone.
i_walker_hound.lore.epic: Followed one scent so fast through the county that it arrived at the picnic before the picnic did.

i_weimaraner.lore.epic: Raided the counter at a wedding and ate the top tier of the cake. Every photo shows a grey dog wearing icing.
i_weimaraner.lore.rare: Opened the fridge with its nose and left it open, so the whole kitchen is now the same temperature as the milk.
i_weimaraner.lore.legendary: Learned to open every door in the office building, then let the whole street's dogs in for a meeting in the boardroom.

i_welsh_springer_spaniel.lore.epic: Sprang into a hedge maze and out the other side, straight through. The maze now has a dog-shaped shortcut.

i_west_highland_white_terrier.lore.epic: Got so muddy at the Highland Games that it took the whole pipe band to wash it. The bagpipes were full of bubbles.

i_whippet.lore.legendary: Ran a lap of the track so fast that it lapped itself and got confused about who had won.
i_whippet.lore.epic: Wore a woolly jumper to the beach on the hottest day of the year and still asked for a towel to lie on.

i_white_wolf.lore.legendary: Howled on the longest night of the winter, and the northern lights came out to see who was making that noise.

i_wire_haired_fox_terrier.lore.legendary: Was hired to sweep the town's chimneys with its wiry coat. Came out black, shook once, and the whole street needed washing.
i_wire_haired_fox_terrier.lore.uncommon: Stands on its back legs at the window and reports every passing cat in a loud, wiry bark.

i_yorkshire_terrier.lore.legendary: Grew its silky show coat so long that it needs two page-boys to carry it on walks. It still stops to bark at pigeons.

elephant.lore.legendary: Rumbled so low that every elephant across the continent felt it in their feet. They all turned up at once for the buffet.

fox.lore.common: Steals one shoe from every doorstep on the street, never the matching one.

giraffe.lore.rare: Spots what everyone is having for dinner two streets away and turns up at the right window, every night.

x_guinea_pig_pet.lore.rare: Rumbles like a tiny motorbike when it is cross. The neighbours keep calling the garage.
x_guinea_pig_pet.lore.epic: Chewed through its hay so fast that the pet shop now orders a whole haystack every Monday.

hamster.lore.legendary: Shredded the whole class's homework to build the cosiest nest in school. The teacher now accepts "the hamster ate it".

hippo.lore.rare: Spins its tail like a fan while it does its business, and the whole riverbank ducks.

horse.lore.epic: Fell asleep standing up in the middle of the parade route. The whole parade tiptoed round it.

lion.lore.epic: Sat on the only waterhole all day, so every animal on the savannah queued with a bucket.

i_capuchin.lore.uncommon: Rubs squashed ants into its fur as bug spray, then wonders why nobody sits next to it.
i_capuchin.lore.common: Taps every nut it finds to check if it's ripe, then knocks on your door too.

i_colobus.lore.uncommon: Hands its baby round the whole troop to babysit, then has a long, quiet lie-down.
i_colobus.lore.rare: Eats leaves that would give any other monkey a tummy ache, then burps at the ones who try.

x_gorilla_ape.lore.rare: Hums happily while eating, so loudly that the whole troop knows exactly who found the best celery.
x_gorilla_ape.lore.common: Burps after every meal to tell the troop it's happy. The troop burps back.

i_guenon.lore.rare: Pulls such funny faces at the rival troop that they forget what they were arguing about.
i_guenon.lore.common: Stuffs its cheek pouches full of fruit for later, then forgets and eats yours.

i_howler_monkey.lore.uncommon: Sleeps fifteen hours a day to save its voice. Nobody dares wake it.
i_howler_monkey.lore.epic: Howled the morning call so reliably that the jungle airport set its clocks by it. Planes now land on the third howl.
i_howler_monkey.lore.legendary: Taught a whole valley of monkeys to howl in harmony. Tourists now pay to hear the morning concert, and bring earplugs.

i_indri.lore.epic: Leapt ten metres between tree trunks, upright, every time. The flying squirrels asked for lessons.

i_langur.lore.epic: Its tail is so long that the whole troop uses it as a washing line. It does not enjoy laundry day.

i_madagascar_cat.lore.epic: Stink-fought the whole neighbouring troop at once. The island had to open every window for a week.
i_madagascar_cat.lore.legendary: Waved its striped tail so high above the forest that ships at sea use it as a lighthouse.

i_marmoset.lore.epic: Started a baby-carrying rota so good that the whole troop runs it like a taxi rank. Babies wait at the stop.
i_marmoset.lore.legendary: Is so small that it slept in a teacup at the jungle café for a week before anyone noticed. Customers kept trying to stir it.

monkey.lore.legendary: Swung across the town hall roof by one hand, waved to the crowd and stole the mayor's speech. It was mostly about bananas.
monkey.lore.common: Peels a banana from the wrong end, the way monkeys really do, and laughs at you for doing it the hard way.

x_orangutan_ape.lore.epic: Gave one long call from the canopy and every orangutan for a mile looked up and started packing.

i_patas.lore.common: Stands on its back legs in the long grass like a soldier on parade, then wanders off mid-salute.
i_patas.lore.legendary: Ran round the savannah so fast that it saw the back of its own head. Says it needs a haircut.
i_patas.lore.epic: Outran the safari jeep and waited at the gate to sell the tourists tickets.

i_proboscis_monkey.lore.rare: Its round pot belly floats so well that it crosses rivers like a furry rubber ring.
i_proboscis_monkey.lore.legendary: Sneezed once across the river and the ferry was blown back to the jetty.

i_siamang.lore.uncommon: Hangs by one arm while eating with the other, and drops the peel on whoever is underneath.
i_siamang.lore.rare: Puffs its throat sac up so big in a storm that it floats a little way down the valley.
i_siamang.lore.legendary: Sang so loudly with its partner that a passing echo got stuck in the valley and is still answering them.

i_spider_monkey.lore.legendary: Hung by its tail from the tallest tree and picked fruit for the whole troop with both hands. They now order by shouting.

i_squirrel_monkey.lore.epic: Bounced so excitedly in a sports shop that every ball in the place went off at once.

i_three_toed_sloth.lore.legendary: Climbed down once a week for fifty years, so the forest built it a lift. It still takes the stairs, slowly.
i_three_toed_sloth.lore.rare: Moves so slowly that moss, moths and a family of beetles have all moved into its fur. It has never been less lonely.

i_titi.lore.epic: Its babies ride on dad's back, and the idea caught on. Every monkey father in the forest now carries a baby, and nobody has a free hand for snacks.

panda.lore.rare: Its black eye patches make it look sad, so zoo visitors keep handing it their sandwiches. It is not sad.
panda.lore.legendary: Peels bamboo so neatly with its extra thumb that the city's top chefs queue for lessons.

sheep.names.legendary: Dame Woolhilda, Queen of the Fleece
sheep.lore.legendary: Escaped so often that the farmer gave up and built the fence around the sheep instead of the field.

squirrel.lore.legendary: Buried so many acorns and forgot them all that half the forest is now its accidental orchard.
squirrel.lore.rare: Crossed the whole town along the telephone wires without touching the ground, and got to the bakery before the bus.

tiger.lore.legendary: Fell asleep in the long grass so perfectly hidden that the safari bus parked on its tail. Nobody has ever reversed so fast.
tiger.lore.rare: Takes a long bath in the pond every afternoon and growls at anyone who wants the pond back.

x_anteater.lore.epic: Slept curled under its own bushy tail in the rain, and the town used it as a bus shelter.

x_antelope.lore.uncommon: Its ears swivel like radar dishes, so it hears a lion yawn a mile away.
x_antelope.lore.epic: Snorted an alarm so loud that the whole savannah ran away, including the lion it was warning about.

x_armadillo.lore.common: Sleeps sixteen hours a day inside its own armour. Never needs a duvet, never shares one.
x_armadillo.lore.epic: Jumped straight up in surprise at the fireworks show and landed on stage. The crowd thought it was the finale.
x_armadillo.lore.rare: Dug a burrow so fast under the fence that the fence ended up on the other side.

x_badger.lore.uncommon: Airs its bedding outside every sunny morning and tuts at anyone with an untidy burrow.

x_buffalo.lore.legendary: Wallowed in the dust so often that its dust bath became the plains' favourite spa. Bookings are full for a year.

x_chinchilla.lore.epic: Left a patch of fur in the cat's paws to escape. The cat now owns the softest bed in the street, and everyone wants one.
x_chinchilla.lore.legendary: Jumped from the floor to the top of the wardrobe in one go and refused to come down until the furniture was rearranged.

x_dingo.lore.rare: Climbs trees and fences like a cat to get to the campsite bins, and looks very proud up there.
x_dingo.lore.legendary: Howled so often over the outback that the echo learned the tune. Campers now hear two dingoes and only see one.

x_donkey.lore.legendary: Refused to take one more step on the mountain path, so the road crew built the new road round it. The bend is still named after it.

x_dugong.lore.uncommon: Surfaces to breathe standing on its tail, like a sailor checking the weather.

x_ferret.lore.epic: Slipped down the back of every sofa in the furniture shop and came out with all the lost coins, two remotes and a very surprised hamster.
x_ferret.lore.legendary: Slept so deeply that it was worn as a scarf to the opera, and woke up only for the applause.

x_gerbil.lore.epic: Chewed every cardboard box in the post office into confetti. Parcels now arrive in a cloud.

x_gibbon.lore.epic: Walked along a telephone wire on two legs, arms up like a tightrope walker. The circus wants its number.

x_hedgehog.lore.legendary: Hibernated so soundly that the gardener built a summer house around it. It woke in spring and complained about the curtains.
x_hedgehog.lore.epic: Rolled into the autumn leaf pile and came out wearing all of it; the park now has one tidy lawn and one walking bonfire-sized heap.

x_hyena.lore.rare: Its clan is run by the females, who marched to the waterhole and took the lions' best spot. The lions are writing a complaint.
x_hyena.lore.epic: Crunched up every bone at the safari barbecue so tidily that the lodge sacked its washing-up team.

x_jackal.lore.rare: Pairs up with its partner for life and they yip duets at the fence posts. The fence posts have not replied.

x_kangaroo.lore.legendary: Hopped so far in one bound that it needed a passport at the other end.

x_kitten_cat.lore.epic: Sharpened its tiny claws on every armchair in the furniture shop. Everything is now sold as "vintage".
x_kitten_cat.lore.legendary: Fell asleep in the bakery window and the queue to watch reached the next town. The bread went cold, nobody minded.

x_lemur.lore.rare: Rubbed its scent on every tree in the park so thoroughly that the dogs refuse to walk there.
x_lemur.lore.legendary: Huddled with its whole troop into one fluffy ball on a cold night, so big that it rolled down the hill to the village and was mistaken for a sheep.

x_manatee.lore.legendary: Visited the power station's warm outflow every winter for so long that the station named its turbines after it.

x_meerkat.lore.legendary: Dug a burrow so grand that the mob has a guest room, a sandpit and a lookout tower with a lift.

x_mongoose.lore.uncommon: Cracks eggs by throwing them backwards between its legs at a rock. The kitchen walls are a disaster.
x_mongoose.lore.legendary: Hid its whole gang in one burrow so tightly that they came out as one big mongoose and argued for an hour about who was the head.

x_opossum.lore.rare: Grins with all fifty of its teeth when it's nervous, which makes everyone else nervous too.
x_opossum.lore.epic: Carried all thirteen of its babies across the high street on its back. The lollipop lady stopped every bus.

x_otter.lore.legendary: Cracked so many shellfish on its favourite stone that the stone wore into a perfect bowl, and it now eats breakfast out of it.

x_platypus.lore.epic: Kicked the museum's stuffed duck with its secret ankle spur, and the duck has been nervous ever since.
x_platypus.names.legendary: The Odd Lot, Puzzle of Nature

x_polar_bear_cub.lore.rare: Waits so patiently by an ice hole that the seals start bringing it snacks to make it leave.
x_polar_bear_cub.lore.epic: Fell asleep on an ice floe and drifted into the harbour. The ferry had to queue behind it.

x_porcupine.lore.legendary: Licked the salt off every road sign in the county. The signs now all say very clean things.

x_possum.lore.epic: Raided every fruit tree on the street in one night and left the pips on each doorstep, sorted by house number.

x_puppy_dog.lore.legendary: Fell asleep in a bakery window for one minute. Customers queued round the block, and the puppy woke up and ate the display.

x_raccoon.lore.epic: Washed every apple in the orchard in the duck pond before the farmer could pick them. The ducks have started queuing for a turn.

x_rat.lore.epic: Chewed a shortcut through every wall on the high street. The shops are now one long shop and nobody can find the exit.
x_rat.lore.legendary: Laughed so hard when the scientist tickled it that the whole lab joined in. Research has stopped for giggles.

x_reindeer_animal.lore.legendary: Grew antlers so wide that the whole herd sheltered under them in a blizzard. Now it sheds them every spring as a ready-made bus shelter.

x_rhino.lore.rare: Can smell a tasty bush from across the plain, but can't see you standing right in front of it.
x_rhino.lore.legendary: Squinted at the lighthouse, decided it was a rival rhino and stared it down for a week. The ships now steer by the rhino.

x_sea_lion.lore.legendary: Swam so fast past the ferry that the passengers thought the ferry was going backwards.
x_sea_lion.lore.epic: Barked along to the brass band on the pier until the band gave up and the sea lions played the encore.

x_seal.lore.legendary: Bobbed up beside every swimmer on the coast so often that the lifeguards now count the seal first.

x_skunk.lore.epic: Dug up the golf course hunting grubs, so every hole is now a hole-in-one.

x_sloth.lore.legendary: Crossed the road so slowly that the council resurfaced the road around it. It still has not reached the other side.
x_sloth.lore.epic: Swam across the river so lazily that the ferry waited and the passengers clapped it in.

x_wallaby.lore.uncommon: Is smaller than a kangaroo and keeps reminding the kangaroos that small is faster.

x_weasel.lore.epic: Danced its war dance in the village square so wildly that the morris dancers asked for lessons.
x_weasel.lore.uncommon: Turns white in winter, then forgets and stays white in a muddy spring.

x_wildebeest.lore.legendary: Looks as if it was built from spare parts (beard, mane, horns, tail) and has the paperwork to prove they are all its own.
x_wildebeest.lore.common: Bucks and kicks for no reason in the middle of grazing, then carries on chewing as if nothing happened.

x_yak.lore.common: Grunts at climbers every morning instead of mooing, then looks offended when nobody understands.
x_yak.lore.legendary: Grunted so deeply on the mountain that the avalanche changed its mind and went back up.
x_yak.lore.epic: Sat on a frozen lake to keep warm and melted a hole big enough for the village to go swimming.

zebra.lore.epic: Started a neck-nibbling grooming line two thousand zebras long, and nobody on the savannah got any sleep for the giggling.
zebra.lore.legendary: Barks like a small dog when it's excited, and every farm dog in the valley answers.
